data.summary:
* Split `apps/code-agent/src/routes/codeRoutes.ts` from 4,786 lines → 48-line thin Fastify plugin that composes 5 resource-specific sub-plugins (`task-routes`, `queue-routes`, `ask-agent-routes`, `feedback-routes`, `linear-routes`) plus shared `schemas.ts`, `responseFormatters.ts`, and `types.ts`.
  * Preserved every one of the 27 original HTTP endpoints verbatim; `apps/code-agent/src/index.ts` is untouched and `codeRoutes.ts` re-exports `timestampToIso`, `taskToApiResponse`, and `inFlightRequests` for back-compat with existing importers/tests.
  * Removed the blanket `/* eslint-disable */`; fixed underlying lint violations (routed `Timestamp` through `@intexuraos/infra-firestore`, converted IIFEs to typed helpers, scoped `no-non-null-assertion` suppression).
  * Added `schemas.test.ts` (Ajv schema validation), `split-sanity.test.ts` (URL-surface assertion via `onRoute` hook), and per-plugin smoke tests; all 15 496 pre-existing tests pass unchanged.
  * Full `pnpm run ci:tracked` green (typecheck, lint, coverage, build); PR #1920 opened against `development`.
